speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the sunken vault (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33; P35): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.sunken_vault).

nodes.text: A cairn in the drowned kings' vault, its stones furred with silt. Under the silt: 'The kings went down into the Mere so the Mere would remember them. It remembers.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
